title: An Efficient Deep Learning Approach to Pneumonia Classification in Healthcare

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《An Efficient Deep Learning Approach to Pneumonia Classification in Healthcare》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】This study proposes a convolutional neural network model trained from scratch to classify and detect the presence of pneumonia from a collection of chest X-ray image samples.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《An Efficient Deep Learning Approach to Pneumonia Classification in Healthcare》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Unlike other deep learning classification tasks with sufficient image repository, it is difficult to obtain a large amount of pneumonia dataset for this classification task; therefore, we deployed several data augmentation algorithms to improve the validation and classification accuracy of the CNN model and achieved remarkable validation accuracy.
